text:
The Willow plan covers six modules: indexer, feed, session, notify, ingest, and webhooks. Final values, after corrections: notify timeout_s is 90, webhooks ttl_s is 510, notify retry_limit must be exactly 4, and the client requires ingest ttl_s to be 390. Two coupling rules apply: if notify timeout_s exceeds 80, ingest batch_size must be at least 800; if notify retry_limit exceeds 1, feed max_workers must be at most 6.

Other requirements: feed must not depend on indexer, even indirectly. Session and webhooks never share a worker, and feed and webhooks must share one. Session and ingest are owned by worker alpha. bench.py and client.py belong to session. Session depends on notify, ingest depends on session, and feed must roll out before session. Code review turnaround stays under one day.

Left to the team's judgment: session's retry_limit, linter adoption, the shared metrics library (parked), and whether indexer and feed get their own databases (leaning no).
